in_english.name: Utbaht
in_english.meaning: Utbaht means elevated or exalted, symbolizing good morals and high character
in_english.long_meaning: Utbaht is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning elevated or exalted. It symbolizes good morals and high character traits. The name has roots in Arabic etymology and holds significance in Islamic tradition. Utbaht is not directly mentioned in the Quran but is derived from the Arabic root 'U-T-B' which connotes elevation and loftiness. Historically, the name has been used among Muslim communities to signify nobility and spiritual excellence.
